code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    top_cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v != bg]
    bot_cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(grid[-1]) if v != bg]
    top_start, bot_start = min(top_cols), min(bot_cols)
    shift = bot_start - top_start
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(1, h-1) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != grid[0][top_start]]
    for r, c, color in markers:
        out[r][c] = 4
        for rr in range(1, r):
            out[rr][c] = color
        other = c + shift
        for rr in range(h-1):
            out[rr][other] = color
    return out
'''
